title: Windows Exporter Metrics

fields.name: scrape_interval
fields.description: The rate at which metrics are collected from the host operating system

fields.name: we.logical_disk.allow_disk_regex
fields.description: Specify the regex for logical disk metrics to allow collection of.

fields.name: we.logical_disk.deny_disk_regex
fields.description: Specify the regex for logical disk metrics to prevent collection of/ignore.

fields.name: we.net.allow_nic_regex
fields.description: Specify the regex for network metrics captured by the name of the NIC, by default captures all NICs but to exclude adjust the regex.

fields.name: we.service.where
fields.description: Specify the WHERE clause for retrieving service metrics.

fields.name: we.service.include
fields.description: Specify the key value pairs for the include condition for the WHERE clause of service metrics.

fields.name: we.service.exclude
fields.description: Specify the key value pairs for the exclude condition for the WHERE clause of service metrics.

fields.name: we.process.allow_process_regex
fields.description: Specify the regex covering the process metrics to collect.

fields.name: we.process.deny_process_regex
fields.description: Specify the regex for process metrics to prevent collection of/ignore.
